label: s1_side02_0000_camera_02
text: Whoa! Where’d you come from? I didn’t even\nnotice you there.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_03
text: Anyway, you are...?\c\nWait, no! Don’t say a thing! I want to guess first.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_04
text: You’re one of the students who came here from\nthe Paldea region on a school trip![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_05
text: Heh heh! It’s a small town, you know. News tends\nto spread pretty quickly![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_06
text: The name’s Perrin, by the way. I’m a traveler with\na bit of a thing for photography.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_07
text: This here’s my bud, Growlithe. Doesn’t the little\nhorn on its head make it the cutest?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_08
text: Hey, this might sound a bit weird, but would it\nbe all right if I took your photo?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_09
text: Just like that, huh? Are you always this open with\ntotal strangers? Kinda worried about you, kiddo![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_10
text: Anyway, let me snap that photo.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_11
text:
So you know better than to put too much trust
in a stranger you just met!\c
Glad to see you’ve got a good head on those
shoulders, kiddo![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_12
text: You’ve got a unique vibe, you know. I like it.\nIt’s a bit different than what I’m used to.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_13
text: I’m gonna be making this town my home base for\na little while.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_14
text:
Why don’t you focus on wrapping up whatever
you’ve got going on for now?\c
Come see me after, I dunno, registering 150
Pokémon in the Kitakami Pokédex or something![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0000_camera_15
text:
Kiddo. Look, I like your gung-ho style, but it
seems to me like you’ve already got something
you need to do, don’t you?\c
Go and catch 150 Pokémon for the Kitakami
Pokédex or something, like a good little student!\c
Come gimme a holler AFTER you’ve done that—
not before.\c
Time is money! Don’t go wasting it![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
